frozen_code_behavior: each batch initializes rejected feedback to empty
accepted partial composition sets current bank/latest and breaks
only fully unsuccessful in-batch decisions are appended to rejected list
next batch does not load previous partial rejection evidence into that field
interpretation: Teacher sees current parent failures and released labels, but not the previous partially rejected proposal replay/reasons. This can cause repeated unsuccessful edits; improvement from carrying the missing feedback must still be evaluated prospectively. Any fixed implementation must preserve which components actually committed and not falsely call the whole previous decision rejected.
future_repair_constraint: Reuse existing TRAIN candidate-feedback path with bounded failure witnesses, no new service/fallback or overriding gates; no hot edit of running v13. Complete B4, then isolate any new method under new contract/run.
